verdict.rationale: Apify's own docs describe a first-party proxy service, Apify Proxy, that rotates datacenter and residential IP addresses to avoid blocking. The SDK adds SessionPool for proxy rotation alongside cookies, so the core story is delivered by the product itself. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of residential vs. datacenter configuration, explicit 'premium' tier details, and independent or hands-on evidence that it gets past hard-to-scrape sites.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use premium residential or datacenter proxies to bypass sites that are hard to scrape

citations.quote: Avoid blocking by smartly rotating datacenter and residential IP addresses.
you can use your own proxy servers, proxy servers acquired from third-party providers, or you can rely on Apify Proxy for your scraping needs.
SessionPool is a class that allows you to handle the rotation of proxy IP addresses along with cookies and other custom settings in Apify SDK.
